findings.summary: module: ESNext paired with moduleResolution: NodeNext — TS 5.x errors TS5095, blocks every downstream typecheck
findings.suggested_fix: Change "module": "ESNext" to "module": "NodeNext" (NodeNext resolution requires the matching module setting).

findings.summary: Root package.json declares no engines.node; ARCHITECTURE.md §1 pins Node 25 for apps/api
findings.suggested_fix: Add top-level field: "engines": { "node": ">=25" } so corepack/CI fail fast on wrong Node.

findings.summary: ARCHITECTURE.md §1 lists 5 services (ui, api, postgres, api-migrate, seed); this wave ships 3. ui+seed are deferred to later sprints — signal only.
findings.suggested_fix: No action this wave. Subsequent waves (task-seed in this sprint; ui in a later sprint) will add the missing service definitions.

findings.summary: postgres image is postgres:17-alpine; sprint task description names postgres:17. Alpine variant uses musl — minor deviation from literal spec.
findings.suggested_fix: Either accept the alpine variant (smaller image, well supported) or change to image: postgres:17 to match the literal task description.

findings.summary: noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature: true added beyond the planner's stated requirements; reasonable tightening, downstream code must use bracket access on index-signature types.
findings.suggested_fix: No change required; flag the tightening so downstream tasks (shared/, modules/) anticipate the stricter access pattern.
